message: • Placed MAYHEM at #2, above TARTARUS and below NOMAD. This pushes NHELV out of the top 10, ARTIFICIAL ASCENT out of the top 25, IDOLS out of the top 50 and HYPERSONIC into the Extended List.

• Release of ESIList v2.0.0 (beta 2)
• Fixed some Visual Glitches
• Added full Admin Control
• Added Tags section to individual profiles
• Placed GRAVITY at #36, above TURBULENT VALLEY and below MOMENT. This pushes Hydratic into the Extended List.

• Release of ESIList v2.0.0 (beta)
• Massive Visual Overhaul: New themes, options and colours
• Mobile App: Now, you can see the list as it should be on your phone
• New Roulette filters
• Added Level Comparator
• Added a bad translation :skull:

• Release of ESIList v1.4.2
• Finished adding all the information to levels: ID, creator, aredl placement and filters.
• Changed score logic by a bit. Now, levels in extended list (between top 75 and 150) will also give points if progressed, just lighter than a mainlist.
• Placed MOMENT at (#35), above TURBULENT VALLEY and below ASMODEUS.

• Release of ESIList v1.4.1
• Made some visual updates for the changelog and leaderboard.

• Placed PSYCHO KILLER at (#87), above SCHIZOPHRENIA and below HURRICANE.
• Placed ASMODEUS at (#34), above TURBULENT VALLEY and below BLADE OF JUSTICE.
• Placed SCHIZOPHRENIA at (#87), above FORBIDDEN ISLE and below HURRICANE.
• Placed KISMET at (#102), above WITHOUT U and below AZURITE.

• Release of ESIList v1.4.0
• Removed skills (unused).
• Added the searchbar on the list.
• Added filters for the searchbar.

• Release of ESIList v1.3.0
• The leaderboard page now shows the player's phrases under each verification, completion and progress.

• Release of ESIList v1.2.0
• The domain has been indexed and the page is accesible on Google by the name "ESIList".

• Release of ESIList v1.1.0
• Added the position history to all levels.
• Fixed that clicking on a verifier's name would take you to the global graph instead of their leaderboard page.
• Fixed that clicking on a record's profile icon would take you to the global graph instead of their leaderboard page.
